description: This file defines a class 'RulesetStandardLibrary' which provides utility functions for endpoint evaluation in AWS SDK, including regex patterns, string and URL manipulation, ARN parsing, partition matching, and function resolution. It appears to be an internal library used for AWS endpoint rules processing.
